period_note: Balance-sheet-free, income-statement-only interim snapshot -- Solo/Standalone presumed (see sources.json). Recovered via a Wayback Machine capture of DSE's OWN company page (dsebd.org/displayCompany.php?name=PUBALIBANK), NOT the bank's site -- the technique proven on RUPALIBANK, applied here for the first time to PUBALIBANK. This vintage of the table (titled 'Financial Performance: <year>', pre-2016) gives only Turn Over, Net Profit After Tax (Continuing Operations), Basic/Diluted EPS and NAV per share, ALL CUMULATIVE FROM JAN 1 per the table's own column headers (Q1=3 Months, Q2=6 Months, Q3=9 Months) -- no period-end market price is given in this table vintage (the top-of-page 'Last Trade' price reflects the capture date, not the quarter-end, so it is not usable and not recorded). Sourced from DSE's (dsebd.org) own company-page interim table, NOT the bank's own site (pubalibangla.com, Cloudflare-blocked). Solo/Standalone basis presumed, consistent with this bank's established series basis, but not explicitly labeled solo vs consolidated on the DSE page itself -- flagged as an assumption, not a confirmed fact (same caveat documented for RUPALIBANK's use of this identical source type). This year's 'Net Profit After Tax (Including Extra-ordinary Income)' row explicitly shows 'n/a' (not '0' as in other years) -- reinforcing that this duplicate row is a genuine non-applicable field for this bank, not a data gap (omitted from line_items throughout this series as redundant with the Continuing-Operations figure, matching the RUPALIBANK precedent of keeping only one of several identical/non-applicable profit variants). Clean reconciliation throughout at a constant 880,373,812-share count (177.08/880.374=0.201; 1252.56/880.374=1.423; 2046.63/880.374=2.325) -- the 31/03/2015 AGM (for FY2014) declared a cash-only dividend, no bonus, no discontinuity.
